title: Agentic World Action Models
summary: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.

AI.title_zh: 智能体世界动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 近期的世界动作模型（world action models）为机器人操作提供了视觉前瞻与未来预测，但缺乏用于组合式技能复用的显式机制。智能体机器人学（agentic robotics）将基于代码的规划与推理同可复用技能相结合，但往往缺乏物理动力学层面的预测性基础（predictive grounding）。我们提出 AW-0，一个智能体世界动作模型框架，它将基于代码的规划与联合的视频和动作预测相整合。我们在统一的 mixture-of-transformers 架构中，将代码、未来视频和机器人动作作为三条相互耦合的生成流进行联合建模。在该架构内，代码专家（code expert）生成参数化技能例程与控制逻辑，而视频专家和动作专家生成未来视觉状态与底层运动指令。代码具有两个互补的作用：它既在世界模型内部构建多步预测与控制的结构，又将技能表示为可供后续智能体执行的、可复用的程序。我们进一步提出了一种自动化数据整理流水线（automated curation pipeline），它为机器人和人类视频轨迹标注对齐的程序，并将反复出现的例程整合为可复用的技能库。在 RoboTwin 2.0 和真实物理双臂操作任务上的评估表明，相比 VLA 与 WAM 基线，任务性能有所提升，同时在语言遵循、语义推理和鲁棒性方面也取得了增益，这表明智能体代码使得 WAM 中规划、预测与执行之间得以建立连接。

title: Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models
summary: Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

AI.title_zh: 重新思考用于交互式世界模型的视频自编码器
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型根据过去的帧和动作预测未来的帧。它们充当模拟器，智能体在其中训练、规划或被评估，人类也可以交互式地控制它们。它们在视频自编码器的潜空间中进行生成，而自编码器的压缩程度决定了其每帧的成本以及每个动作需要等待多久才能生效。然而，世界模型往往复用文本到视频生成器的自编码器，这些自编码器是为离线生成而构建的，没有智能体在等待，而且在没有其训练数据和代码的情况下，无法在另一种压缩率下重新训练。因此，我们追问：世界模型应当如何压缩、在何处压缩以及压缩多少。我们构建了 CADRE，这是一个开放的因果扩散表示自编码器（causal diffusion representation autoencoder）系列，涵盖多种时空压缩。其各成员仅在冻结特征上的一个小瓶颈处有所不同，并共享一个经自蒸馏至一步或少数几步的扩散解码器。我们在每个自编码器上训练同一个世界模型，涉及两个领域：操作（manipulation）与导航（navigation），每个领域各有两个环境。CADRE 构成了大部分延迟-质量前沿（latency-quality frontier），尤其是在摄像机移动的情况下。我们的研究还得出四项发现。在强压缩下，扩散解码器比感知回归更清晰。在机器人操作中，时间压缩在自编码器中比在世界模型中更有效。操作与导航需要相反的压缩方式：当摄像机静止时，时间压缩代价很小；而当摄像机移动时，则是空间压缩代价很小。令人惊讶的是，在摄像机静止的情况下，更粗粒度的空间 token 对运动的损害远大于对图像质量的损害。代码、模型和在线演示见 https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

title: VoxProg: 3D Spatial Reasoning through Voxel Programming
summary: Language models' abilities to interpret tasks and generate programs offer a promising basis for 3D spatial reasoning. Yet following spatial instructions in 3D scenes requires programs to construct geometric references that language leaves implicit. In this work, we introduce VoxProg, which formulates 3D object placement through voxel programming: a language model translates task interpretations into executable programs over local voxel views of scene surfaces. Because these views index surface geometry on regular grids with explicit coordinates and neighborhood relations, an evidence program can isolate task-relevant regions and boundaries directly from scene meshes, and a downstream pose program can measure the resulting geometry to compute a target $SE(3)$ pose. Visual and numerical feedback from execution lets the model inspect intermediate selections and candidate placements to iteratively revise its code. To evaluate open-ended placement across functional use, geometric fit, and contextual arrangements, we introduce the 71-task VoxProg-Bench benchmark along with an evaluation suite pairing perceptual Intent Alignment and 3D Physical Validity. Across VoxProg-Bench and external benchmarks, VoxProg consistently outperforms relation-based, keypoint-based, and mesh-based baselines.

AI.title_zh: VoxProg：通过体素编程进行三维空间推理
AI.abstract_zh: 语言模型在解读任务与生成程序方面的能力，为三维空间推理提供了有前景的基础。然而，在三维场景中遵循空间指令，要求程序构建出语言所隐含的几何参照。在本工作中，我们提出 VoxProg，它通过体素编程（voxel programming）来形式化三维物体放置：语言模型将任务解读转化为可在场景表面的局部体素视图上执行的程序。由于这些视图以显式坐标与邻接关系在规则网格上索引表面几何，证据程序（evidence program）可以直接从场景网格中分离出与任务相关的区域和边界，而下游的姿态程序（pose program）则可以测量所得几何以计算目标 $SE(3)$ 姿态。执行过程中产生的视觉与数值反馈使模型能够检查中间选择与候选放置，从而迭代修正其代码。为了评估在功能用途、几何贴合与语境布置方面的开放式放置，我们引入了包含 71 项任务的 VoxProg-Bench 基准，以及一套结合感知层面的意图对齐（Intent Alignment）与三维物理有效性（3D Physical Validity）的评估套件。在 VoxProg-Bench 与外部基准上，VoxProg 持续优于基于关系、基于关键点和基于网格的基线方法。

title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
summary: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. PhysiCalWorld is trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels. At inference time, the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead. We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate. The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training.

AI.title_zh: PhysiCalWorld：面向世界模型的上下文物理校准
AI.abstract_zh: 现有的世界模型通常仅通过当前视觉帧或狭窄的历史窗口来感知场景。然而，这些观测可能无法揭示决定转移动力学（transition dynamics）的物理属性，例如物体的质量分布、关节阻尼或表面摩擦。若不为世界模型校准这些物理因素，预测往往会向经验先验（empirical prior）回归，并在新的测试场景中引发严重漂移。为此，我们提出 PhysiCalWorld，它通过上下文提示（in-context prompting），在不进行微调（fine-tuning）或解析物理建模的情况下，将动作条件世界模型（action-conditioned world models）校准到实例特定的动力学。我们的方法将测试场景内采集的探索性交互片段编码为紧凑的物理描述符 token（physics descriptor token），从而将后续预测锚定于该场景的实际物理行为。PhysiCalWorld 仅以潜在预测损失（latent prediction loss）进行端到端训练，无需物理标签。在推理时，描述符 token 只需提取一次，即可在多次 rollout 中复用，计算开销可忽略不计。我们在涵盖多样物理变化的四个环境中评估 PhysiCalWorld，结果表明它显著提升了 rollout 预测精度与视觉规划成功率。所学习到的描述符还形成了一个具有物理结构的潜在空间，并能泛化到训练期间所见的物理范围之外。

title: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models
comment: 35 pages (15 main + 20 supplementary), 13 figures, 26 tables. Project page: https://ucsc-vlaa.github.io/ALPS/ Code: https://github.com/UCSC-VLAA/ALPS
summary: World models turn visual representations into predictions and actions. We argue that their visual foundation should combine physical-state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, so that a single representation can support prediction, instruction, and inspection. However, existing encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities; we therefore introduce ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies all three in a single set of patch tokens. Using only still images and text, we pretrain a ViT-B/16 from scratch with language, reconstruction, and spatial correspondence objectives, and then refine it via cross-view self-distillation. In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5x larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction. Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection. We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.

AI.title_zh: ALPS：面向世界模型的视觉状态编码器
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型将视觉表征转化为预测与动作。我们认为，其视觉基础应当融合物理状态信息、原生语言对齐以及像素重建，从而使单一表征能够同时支持预测、指令与检查。然而，现有编码器通常仅专精于其中一到两种能力；因此我们提出 ALPS，一种预训练的视觉状态编码器，在一组统一的 patch token 中融合上述三种能力。仅使用静态图像与文本，我们从零开始预训练一个 ViT-B/16，采用语言、重建与空间对应目标，随后通过跨视角自蒸馏对其进行精炼。在涵盖十五个公开编码器的统一评估中，ALPS 在 ViT-B 模型中取得了最低的 LIBERO 状态探针总体误差（与规模大 3.5 倍的 V-JEPA 2-L 相当），同时保持强语言对齐与准确的像素重建。在下游任务中，冻结的 ALPS token 与我们原生的文本塔搭配使用时，在 LIBERO 上取得最高的平均策略成功率（85.5%），在 PushT、Wall 与 Granular 上的世界模型规划中达到或超过领先编码器，并使预测的未来 token 能够直接解码为像素以供视觉检查。我们希望这项工作有助于将视觉预训练确立为世界模型中理解、预测与动作的共同基础。

title: Attn-Forcing: Learning Full-Context Attention Proxies for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Increasing the attention context length significantly improves streaming video generation quality, while incurring prohibitive memory and computational costs as the context grows. Existing methods attempt to capture this contextual information through attention selection or compression, but remain limited by bounded representations and lack explicit attention-level supervision to retain historical contributions to current queries. To address this, we introduce Attn-Forcing, a novel framework that preserves full-context attention contributions for streaming video generation under bounded memory and computation. We achieve this by introducing attention proxies that continuously approximate the attention responses induced by the historical context. Specifically, we implement the proxies as learnable visual latents and employ a Proxy Update Module to incorporate visual context from historical latents. Moreover, we propose an Attention Matching Loss to explicitly constrain the attention behavior of the learned proxies using full-context attention supervision. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that Attn-Forcing consistently improves streaming video generation quality and achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing baseline methods.

AI.title_zh: Attn-Forcing：为流式视频生成学习全上下文注意力代理
AI.abstract_zh: 增大注意力上下文长度可显著提升流式视频生成质量，但随着上下文增长会带来难以承受的内存与计算开销。现有方法试图通过注意力选择或压缩来捕获这种上下文信息，但仍受限于有界的表示，且缺乏显式的注意力层面监督以保留历史信息对当前查询的贡献。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Attn-Forcing，这是一种新颖的框架，可在有界的内存与计算下为流式视频生成保留全上下文注意力贡献。我们通过引入注意力代理（attention proxies）来实现这一点，这些代理持续近似由历史上下文所诱导的注意力响应。具体而言，我们将这些代理实现为可学习的视觉潜变量，并采用代理更新模块（Proxy Update Module）以纳入来自历史潜变量的视觉上下文。此外，我们提出注意力匹配损失（Attention Matching Loss），利用全上下文注意力监督显式约束所学代理的注意力行为。大量定性与定量实验表明，Attn-Forcing 能够持续提升流式视频生成质量，并在现有基线方法之上取得最先进的性能。

title: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material. To appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/realme
summary: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.

AI.title_zh: RealMe：从极简采集生成沉浸式体积视频
AI.abstract_zh: 本文研究从稀疏且低分辨率的采集资源创建沉浸式体积视频的问题。传统的密集多视角重建方法能够生成高质量的体积视频，但其对昂贵采集设备的依赖使其在真实场景中难以实际应用。近期的方法使用生成模型来放宽采集要求，但仍受限于分辨率有限和4D不一致性。为克服这些限制，我们提出RealMe，这是一个围绕高分辨率视频扩散模型构建的统一框架，它将有限的采集增强为高分辨率（2K）、4D一致的视频，用于体积视频重建。具体而言，RealMe从采集视频中构建辅助数据，并将其连同布局感知的位置嵌入一起编码为潜在表示（latents）。该视频扩散模型将因子化的时空注意力适配到多视角采集布局，跨视角和时间对这些潜在表示进行去噪，并将其解码为增强视频以细化4D表示。这一适配有助于模型捕捉时间动态和多视角关系，从而产生更具4D一致性的生成结果。为缩小生成视频与真实采集之间的数据差距，我们应用了一种潜在频率损失（latent frequency loss），在潜在空间中提供频域监督。在公开的DNA-Rendering基准和自采集的RealVV数据集上的大量实验表明，RealMe能够创建沉浸式体积视频，并在视觉保真度和4D一致性方面优于现有最先进方法。

title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.

AI.title_zh: 着眼未来：自回归视频生成中的未来演化建模
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归视频扩散模型逐块（chunk by chunk）生成视频，然而生成看似合理的后续内容并不保证其捕捉到了场景如何演化。在教师强制（teacher forcing）下，强时间冗余可能使局部视觉连续性成为当前块去噪的捷径，从而降低了对视觉演化建模的压力。我们提出了未来块预测（Future Chunk Prediction, FCP），这是一个与教师强制去噪联合优化的辅助目标，它在无法获取中间视觉上下文的情况下预测时间上相隔的块。FCP 直接从训练视频中获取监督，不需要额外的预训练视觉编码器，且不改变自回归推理过程。与标准的教师强制自回归训练相比，我们的方法在更低的总训练计算预算下实现了更优的物理合理性，凸显了未来块监督在建模视觉演化方面的有效性和效率。有趣的是，我们的可视化结果表明，FCP 促成了一个更具结构化的表示空间，这可能对构建自回归世界模型具有价值。

title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
summary: Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.

AI.title_zh: CausalAlign：面向一致自我运动的视频生成模型因果对齐
AI.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的视频生成模型（VGMs）能够生成视觉上合理的视频，然而其相机自我运动往往在长时序范围内发生漂移。相机自我运动决定了视角在帧与帧之间如何变化，对于保持一致几何与轨迹至关重要。为解决这一问题，我们提出 CausalAlign，一个包含两个组成部分的因果对齐框架。首先，我们使用线性探针和因果干预来诊断精确的自我运动在 VGMs 中如何被表示、使用和保留，揭示了去噪过程中的“先升后降”模式。其次，我们通过 delta-token 空间将所识别层的表示与一个 3D 基础模型对齐，从而强化 VGM 中的自我运动状态。该空间编码连续帧之间的变化，使对齐能够聚焦于自我运动动态而非静态场景内容。在 DL3DV 和 RealEstate10K 上微调 Wan2.2 后，CausalAlign 能够大幅提升运动精度、几何一致性和时间平滑度，同时保持视觉质量。例如，相对于基础模型，它将几何一致性提升了 20% 以上。此外，借助微调后的 VGM，CausalAlign 在 RoboCasa365 基准的移动操作任务上将世界动作模型（WAMs）的成功率提升了 10 个百分点。总体而言，CausalAlign 提升了基于扩散的 VGMs 中的自我运动一致性，并在具身模型中带来了显著收益。

title: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.

AI.title_zh: GeoMem-VLA：将三维场景理解内化到视觉-语言-动作模型的时间记忆中
AI.abstract_zh: 几何结构对于机器人操作和理解三维世界至关重要。大多数VLA模型依赖当前观测的二维表征，而几何感知方法往往需要额外的三维信息。然而，从单个观测中独立推断出的几何信息常常被丢弃，而未能累积为持久的任务表征。我们的核心洞见是：动作生成需要一种紧凑、与任务相关的几何抽象，且该抽象能够被持续更新，而非在每一步都需要完整、可渲染的三维重建。我们提出GeoMem-VLA，一个VLA框架，它将显式的三维监督内化为专用的几何token，并将其作为时间记忆加以维护以用于动作生成，且不直接将VLM原生的视觉嵌入与教师特征空间对齐。在训练过程中，一个冻结的几何基础模型通过在当前场景点图与未来末端执行器轨迹上的几何流匹配目标，对可学习的GeoPlan token进行监督。这些token与观测表征的记忆相整合，其中历史信息被检索、与当前观测自适应融合，并随着任务推进被巩固以保留事件帧。在推理时，策略检索历史表征并将其与当前工作表征融合以预测动作，而无需调用三维教师模型或显式重建场景。经过针对基准的下游适配后，GeoMem-VLA在LIBERO上取得98.9%的平均成功率，在RoboTwin的干净/随机化设置下分别取得91.10% / 91.24%。在五个真实世界任务上，GeoMem-VLA取得78.0%的平均成功率。这些结果表明，内化并记忆三维场景理解是机器人控制的一种有前景的方法。

title: Robot Generalization Beyond Volume: The Diversity Path via Zero-Shot Capabilities
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables, including supplementary material
summary: General-purpose robots must handle tasks, objects and environments they were never trained on, yet zero-shot generalization remains one of the least solved problems in physical AI. In digital AI, zero-shot capability grew with the volume and, above all, the diversity of training data, much of it sourced from the crowd. Robotics instead relies on paid collection by a few well-funded teams, which yields volume without diversity. We formulate zero-shot generalization in physical AI as coverage of the deployment distribution, and show that more samples from the same collectors shrink the unseen region only slowly, while each new contributor can extend it. Building on this and on zero-shot learning, we propose a shared latent space for robot actions that combines multi-modal alignment, generative augmentation, and noisy-label learning. As a scalable source of diverse data, we propose a community of developers building applications on one standard, approachable robot, Origami. We close with a testable hypothesis and an evaluation protocol relating real-robot zero-shot success to the diversity of contributed data.

AI.title_zh: 超越数据量的机器人泛化：经由零样本能力的多样性之路
AI.abstract_zh: 通用机器人必须处理它们从未训练过的任务、物体和环境，然而零样本泛化仍然是物理人工智能（physical AI）中解决得最少的问题之一。在数字人工智能中，零样本能力随着训练数据的规模、尤其是多样性而增长，其中大部分数据来自众包。机器人领域则相反，依赖少数资金充足的团队进行付费采集，这带来了规模却没有带来多样性。我们将物理人工智能中的零样本泛化表述为对部署分布的覆盖，并表明：来自相同采集者的更多样本只会缓慢地缩小未见区域，而每一个新的贡献者都能扩展该区域。基于这一点以及零样本学习，我们提出一种面向机器人动作的共享潜空间，它结合了多模态对齐、生成式增强和噪声标签学习。作为多样数据的可扩展来源，我们提出一个开发者社区，他们在一种标准、易上手的机器人 Origami 上构建应用。最后，我们给出一个可检验的假设以及一套将真实机器人零样本成功率与所贡献数据的多样性相关联的评估协议。

title: OMAR: Open-World Multi-Attribute Reasoning for Scene-Conditioned Shelf Organization
summary: With the advent of foundation models, robots are increasingly capable of understanding and executing explicitly specified human tasks. Extending these capabilities to open-ended tasks, however, requires robots to infer appropriate actions from the observed scene. Household organization exemplifies this challenge, as robots must often act without detailed instructions, predefined object vocabularies, or known object-receptacle associations. While robots may follow instructions or learn organization preferences from demonstrations, inferring the latent organization of an occasionally changing scene and placing a novel object consistently with it remains challenging. We propose an open-world multi-attribute reasoning pipeline that grounds unknown objects across views and constructs an instance-level 3D scene graph for placement reasoning. First, a vision-language model proposes labels together with attributes such as content and packaging type, which are grounded through segmentation, depth, and multi-view association. Then, an LLM reasons over this representation to infer the latent shelf organization and rank scene-consistent object placements without explicitly user-provided preferences. The resulting placement rankings guide subsequent geometric and kinematic feasibility checks for execution. Our experimental evaluation shows that our approach leads to improved instance mapping and placement coherence over single-view language-grounding and geometry-only baselines, enabling autonomous placement of previously unseen objects without predefined object-receptacle mappings or class-specific retraining.

AI.title_zh: OMAR：面向场景条件货架整理的开世界多属性推理
AI.abstract_zh: 随着基础模型的出现，机器人越来越有能力理解并执行明确指定的人类任务。然而，要将这些能力扩展到开放式任务，机器人需要从观测到的场景中推断出合适的动作。家庭整理正是这一挑战的典型体现，因为机器人往往必须在没有详细指令、没有预定义物体词表、也没有已知物体—容纳容器关联关系的情况下行动。尽管机器人可以遵循指令或从演示中学习整理偏好，但推断一个偶有变化的场景的潜在整理方式，并将一个新物体以与该整理方式一致的方式放置，仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种开世界多属性推理流程，它跨视角对未知物体进行定位（grounding），并构建实例级3D场景图以用于放置推理。首先，一个视觉—语言模型提出标签以及内容和包装类型等属性，这些标签与属性通过分割、深度和多视角关联实现定位。然后，一个LLM在该表示上进行推理，以推断潜在的货架整理方式，并在没有用户显式提供偏好的情况下，对与场景一致的物体放置进行排序。所得的放置排序指导后续用于执行的几何与运动学可行性检查。我们的实验评估表明，相较于单视角语言定位和仅基于几何的基线，我们的方法带来了更好的实例映射和放置一致性，使得机器人能够在没有预定义物体—容纳容器映射、也没有类别特定再训练的情况下，自主放置此前未见过的物体。

title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
comment: 93 pages, 15 figures, 21 tables. Project page: https://physical2rsi.github.io/
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.

AI.title_zh: 迈向物理人工智能中的递归自我改进
AI.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement, RSI）描述的是一个不仅改进自身行为、还改进其改进过程本身的系统。近期的数字智能体通过重写自身代码并用可执行测试检验每个版本，来验证这一思想。将这些机制引入物理世界，需要从部分观测中通过代价高昂的试错进行学习，同时要应对不断变化的工作条件以及可能不可逆的后果。我们将RSI置于机器人学习的框架之中，并梳理从提升机器人能力到提升生成这些能力的过程的路径。我们考察物理经验如何能够强化这些改进机制，以及由此产生的收益在何种情况下能够支撑机制自身的进一步自我改进。只有当反馈针对尚未满足的学习需求、接收组件能够利用该变化、其价值在任务或硬件变化后依然保持，且持续实践仍安全且可负担时，收益才能被传递下去。现有研究集中于操作（manipulation）领域，支持了行为改进、对后续学习的助益以及过程改进。部分系统还改变了改进者的知识或工具，但本文所综述的物理研究尚未能分离出可归因于递归的收益。我们将这些发现综合为评估原则与研究方向，以期为那些能够通过一次次试错、安全地改进其改进方式的机器提供指引。

title: CineEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolution Framework for Cinematic Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve.

AI.title_zh: CineEvolve：一种用于电影级多镜头视频生成的智能体自我演化框架
AI.abstract_zh: 电影级多镜头视频生成既需要叙事规划，也需要迭代式精修。现有方法要么缺乏叙事推理能力，要么依赖没有策略更新的前馈式工作流。本文提出 CineEvolve，一种用于电影级多镜头视频生成的智能体自我演化框架，它将 Director（导演）与 Critic（评论者）统一在同一个视觉-语言策略之中。通过模拟真实电影制作中将迭代式指导与批判性反馈相结合的过程，我们采用交替强化学习训练 CineEvolve：其中 Director 揭示缺陷以磨砺 Critic，而更新后的 Critic 则引导 Director 进行有针对性的修改。为稳定协同演化，我们引入 Evolutionary GRPO（E-GRPO，演化式 GRPO），利用历史锚定与修订保护机制来缓解优势膨胀。此外，我们贡献了 CineTraj，一个涵盖创作、评论与修订的 40K 电影级轨迹数据集。大量实验表明，CineEvolve 优于现有方法。我们的代码将发布于 https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve。

title: Guess and Send: World-Model-Guided Semantic Packet Transmission for Robust Video Perception
summary: Reliable video perception over bandwidth-constrained wireless links requires transmitting information that the receiver cannot already recover from its evolving scene representation. This paper introduces WorldGT, a world-model-guided semantic packet transmission framework that prioritizes information according to its contribution to the receiver's perception. A shared feature-space world model predicts the receiver's scene state through affine motion compensation and learned residual displacement, while sender-side verification identifies reusable predictions. An acknowledgment-synchronized receiver twin estimates task-impact scores through two counterfactual evaluations, guiding packet selection and unequal error protection over LDPC-coded wireless channels. A compact 3-bit feature representation increases spatial coverage under stringent bandwidth constraints, while predictive fallback sustains perception during packet outages. Experiments on KITTI and VisDrone under Rayleigh fading and AWGN demonstrate substantial gains in low-SNR conditions. On KITTI at a 4.13% reference bandwidth budget, WorldGT achieves 47.5% J&F at 0 dB Rayleigh SNR, outperforming H.264 by 11.3 percentage points. Controlled ablations show that world-model prediction contributes up to 8.7 points under Rayleigh fading. Object-detection experiments further demonstrate the transferability of receiver-relative predictive transmission across visual perception tasks. These results establish world-model-guided, receiver-state-aware transmission as an effective approach to robust video perception under severe communication constraints.

AI.title_zh: 先猜后传：面向鲁棒视频感知的世界模型引导语义数据包传输
AI.abstract_zh: 在带宽受限的无线链路上实现可靠的视频感知，需要传输接收端无法从其不断演化的场景表征中自行恢复的信息。本文提出 WorldGT，一个由世界模型引导的语义数据包传输框架，它依据信息对接收端感知的贡献程度来确定传输优先级。一个共享特征空间的世界模型通过仿射运动补偿和学习到的残差位移来预测接收端的场景状态，同时发送端的验证机制识别可复用的预测。一个与确认（ACK）同步的接收端孪生体通过两次反事实评估来估计任务影响分数，从而指导数据包选择以及在 LDPC 编码无线信道上的不等错误保护。一种紧凑的 3 比特特征表示在严格的带宽约束下提高了空间覆盖范围，而预测式回退机制则能在数据包中断期间维持感知。在瑞利衰落和 AWGN 条件下于 KITTI 和 VisDrone 上的实验表明，该方法在低信噪比条件下取得了显著提升。在 KITTI 上，于 4.13% 的参考带宽预算下，WorldGT 在 0 dB 瑞利信噪比下达到 47.5% 的 J&F，比 H.264 高出 11.3 个百分点。受控消融实验表明，在瑞利衰落条件下，世界模型预测的贡献最高可达 8.7 个百分点。目标检测实验进一步证明了相对于接收端的预测式传输可跨视觉感知任务迁移。这些结果确立了世界模型引导的、感知接收端状态的传输方式，是在严苛通信约束下实现鲁棒视频感知的一种有效途径。

title: Sparsity Should Be ALLOTted by Output: Training-Free Allocation of Block-Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Full 3D attention is costly in video Diffusion Transformers. Block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only selected attention blocks. However, existing methods either overlook the potential to optimize sparsity allocation or rely on heuristic rules or local metrics to guide it. In this work, we observe that sparsifying attention in different layers and at different denoising steps affects final-video fidelity to substantially different degrees. Yet the identities of the most sensitive layer-step pairs remain nearly unchanged across inputs. Building on these findings, we propose Allocating Layer-step Latency by Output Tests (ALLOT), a training-free sparsity allocation method. Treating each layer-step pair as a cell, ALLOT estimates each cell's contribution to final-video error through (i) cell probing and (ii) trajectory calibration, then jointly optimizes cell densities under a measured-latency budget. It preserves existing selection strategies and kernels, replacing only the allocation component. At equal or shorter wall-clock time, ALLOT outperforms every compared allocation strategy with XAttention, with an 11.8 dB PSNR gain on HunyuanVideo. Extensive experiments across four additional published pipelines on Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo show that ALLOT outperforms or ties the default in all nine settings.

AI.title_zh: 稀疏性应按输出进行ALLOT分配：面向视频扩散Transformer的免训练块稀疏注意力分配
AI.abstract_zh: 全3D注意力在视频扩散Transformer中开销高昂。块稀疏注意力通过仅计算选定的注意力块来降低这一开销。然而，现有方法要么忽视了优化稀疏性分配的潜力，要么依赖启发式规则或局部指标来指导分配。在本工作中，我们观察到，在不同层和不同去噪步上进行注意力稀疏化，对最终视频保真度的影响程度存在显著差异。然而，最敏感的层-步对（layer-step pairs）的组成在不同输入之间几乎保持不变。基于这些发现，我们提出通过输出测试分配层-步延迟（Allocating Layer-step Latency by Output Tests，ALLOT），一种免训练的稀疏性分配方法。ALLOT将每个层-步对视为一个单元（cell），通过（i）单元探测（cell probing）和（ii）轨迹校准（trajectory calibration）来估计每个单元对最终视频误差的贡献，然后在实测延迟预算下联合优化各单元的密度。它保留了现有的选择策略与内核，仅替换分配组件。在相同或更短的墙钟时间下，ALLOT配合XAttention优于所有对比的分配策略，在HunyuanVideo上取得11.8 dB的PSNR提升。在Wan2.1、Wan2.2和HunyuanVideo上针对另外四个已发表管线的广泛实验表明，ALLOT在所有九种设置下均优于或持平默认方法。

title: Events, Not Pixels: Where World Models Get the Return Wrong
summary: World models are increasingly used for planning, where a planner ranks candidate actions by returns imagined by the model. However, these models are judged mainly by how well they render frames, even though a visually faithful rollout can still assign the wrong return. To identify where this mismatch arises, we introduce a transition-level diagnostic that replaces imagined transitions with real ones and measures the reduction in return error against a budget-matched random control. Our analysis yields two findings. (1) Event transitions, the few steps where a reward is earned or an episode ends, are rendered as well as other steps (median pixel-error ratio 0.85), yet restoring them removes a median of 70% of the return error. In contrast, restoring transitions with the largest MSE, SSIM or LPIPS error removes less than a random choice. Across the 44 Atari-100k model--collection pairs that pass our reliability checks, including three released families, event patches outperform random patches in 39 (sign test p=1.4 x 10^{-7}), with a median gain of +44 percentage points. (2) The remaining error is structured: a complementary patch separates errors at true events from those elsewhere, while an eight-step timing tolerance recovers few events missed by our deterministic models. This structure also guides repair: a rule recorded before four repair outcomes were known predicts when a diffusion model repairs these failures. Event patches improve plan ranking, and the same concentration appears on control tasks with rare reward events.

AI.title_zh: 事件，而非像素：世界模型在哪里把回报弄错
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型越来越多地被用于规划，其中规划器根据模型所想象的回报对候选动作进行排序。然而，这些模型主要是通过其渲染帧的效果来评判的，尽管视觉上忠实的推演仍可能给出错误的回报。为找出这种不匹配的根源，我们引入一种转场级（transition-level）诊断方法：用真实转场替换想象的转场，并相对于预算匹配的随机对照来衡量回报误差的降低量。我们的分析得出两项发现。(1) 事件转场，即获得奖励或回合结束的少数几步，其渲染质量与其他步骤相当（像素误差比值中位数为 0.85），但恢复这些转场可消除回报误差的中位数为 70%。相比之下，恢复 MSE、SSIM 或 LPIPS 误差最大的转场，所消除的误差还不如随机选择。在通过我们可靠性检验的 44 个 Atari-100k 模型—集合配对中（包括三个已发布的家族），事件片段在 39 个配对中优于随机片段（符号检验 p=1.4 x 10^{-7}），增益中位数为 +44 个百分点。(2) 其余误差是有结构的：一个互补片段将真实事件处的误差与其他位置的误差区分开来，而八步的时间容差只能找回少数被我们的确定性模型漏掉的事件。这种结构也指导修复：一条在四种修复结果已知之前记录的规则，能够预测扩散模型何时会修复这些失败。事件片段可改善规划排序，且同样的集中现象也出现在具有稀疏奖励事件的控制任务上。

title: LiveAct: Towards Real-Time Multi-Agent World Models with Heterogeneous Action Interfaces
summary: Interactive video world models predict how an environment evolves under user actions, but most existing systems assume one controlled agent and one task-specific action interface. We study multi-agent video world modeling, where one model generates a joint visual future for multiple controlled agents while interpreting heterogeneous controls ranging from binary game buttons to continuous robot commands. This task presents two complementary challenges. First, every agent-indexed action stream must control its intended visual entity independently. Second, the model must adapt the meaning of each control variable across different tasks, where the same tensor dimension may denote an attack, steering command, or robot command. We introduce LiveAct, centered on a Heterogeneous Action Interface (HAI) whose two components mirror this decomposition. To support independent control, Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation uses language-driven spatial gates and agent-specific attention to bind each action stream to its intended visual agent. To accommodate heterogeneous controls, Schema-Guided Action Adaptation describes each control variable in language and modulates its semantic token with the synchronized numerical value. We further transfer the complete interface to a blockwise causal generator through teacher forcing and rollout-aware distribution matching, enabling efficient streaming generation while retaining agent-specific control and action semantics. We instantiate the formulation on six multi-agent sources spanning games and multi-robot manipulation, and evaluate visual quality, action following, agent attribution, and latency. Across games and robot manipulation, LiveAct reaches 0.898 and 0.942 agent-attribution accuracy without agent locations or identity crops, and the causal generator attains 17.70 FPS at $512\times 448$.

AI.title_zh: LiveAct：面向实时多智能体世界模型的异构动作接口
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式视频世界模型预测环境在用户动作下的演化，但现有大多数系统假设只有一个受控智能体和一个任务特定的动作接口。我们研究多智能体视频世界建模，即由单一模型为多个受控智能体生成联合的视觉未来，同时解释从二值游戏按键到连续机器人指令的异构控制信号。该任务带来两个互补的挑战。第一，每条以智能体为索引的动作流必须独立地控制其对应的视觉实体。第二，模型必须适配每个控制变量在不同任务中的含义，其中同一张量维度可能表示攻击、转向指令或机器人指令。我们提出 LiveAct，其核心是异构动作接口（Heterogeneous Action Interface, HAI），其两个组成部分分别对应上述分解。为支持独立控制，Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation 使用语言驱动的空间门控与智能体特定的注意力，将每条动作流绑定到其对应的视觉智能体。为容纳异构控制，Schema-Guided Action Adaptation 用语言描述每个控制变量，并用同步的数值调制其语义 token。我们进一步通过教师强制与感知 rollout 的分布匹配，将完整接口迁移到分块因果生成器上，从而在保留智能体特定控制与动作语义的同时实现高效的流式生成。我们在涵盖游戏与多机器人操作在内的六个多智能体数据源上实例化该形式化框架，并评估视觉质量、动作跟随、智能体归因与延迟。在游戏与机器人操作任务上，LiveAct 在无智能体位置信息或无身份裁剪的情况下分别达到 0.898 和 0.942 的智能体归因准确率，且因果生成器在 $512\times 448$ 下达到 17.70 FPS。

title: RadioDreamer: A World Model for Radio Map Forecasting and Imagination-Based Optimization
summary: Radio maps characterize the spatial distribution of wireless conditions and are fundamental to network planning and optimization. However, existing learning-based methods reconstruct isolated radio-map snapshots and do not model how network actions drive the evolution of the radio environment. In this paper, we present RadioDreamer, a two-stage world model that unifies action-conditioned radio-map forecasting and imagination-based network optimization within a latent space. To learn causal environmental transitions from sequential interactions, we introduce a structured spatio-temporal transformer backbone coupled with dynamic-region supervision, enabling accurate modeling of action-sensitive areas. Second, rather than relying on conventional physical trial-and-error, RadioDreamer establishes a general planning paradigm that generates counterfactual latent trajectories to evaluate and optimize long-horizon network parameter configurations. Experiments show that RadioDreamer improves both multi-step rollout forecasting and closed-loop network optimization. It reduces full-map forecasting error by 25.2% on average and achieves approximately 80% accuracy in predicting the evolution direction of radio signals. More importantly, for long-horizon network configuration, imagination-based planning surpasses model-free policies optimized directly on radio-map observations by 8.8% in accumulated return.

AI.title_zh: RadioDreamer：用于无线电地图预测与基于想象优化的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 无线电地图刻画无线条件的空间分布，是网络规划与优化的基础。然而，现有基于学习的方法只重建孤立的无线电地图快照，并未对网络动作如何驱动无线电环境演化进行建模。本文提出 RadioDreamer，这是一个两阶段世界模型，在潜在空间中将动作条件下的无线电地图预测与基于想象的网络优化统一起来。为了从序贯交互中学习因果性的环境转移，我们引入了结构化的时空 transformer 主干网络，并结合动态区域监督，从而能够对动作敏感区域进行准确建模。其次，RadioDreamer 不依赖传统的物理试错，而是建立了一种通用规划范式，通过生成反事实潜在轨迹来评估并优化长时程网络参数配置。实验表明，RadioDreamer 同时改善了多步推演预测和闭环网络优化。它将全图预测误差平均降低 25.2%，并在预测无线电信号演化方向方面达到约 80% 的准确率。更重要的是，对于长时程网络配置，基于想象的规划在累积回报上比直接在无线电地图观测上优化的无模型策略高出 8.8%。

title: SpatialBrain: Spatial Intelligence Growing from Experience
summary: Spatial reasoning requires more than access to geometric tools: a reasoner must decide when direct observation is sufficient and when to reconstruct, measure, or change reference frames. We present SpatialBrain, a framework that retains experience about these decisions while keeping its vision-language backbone fixed. The key distinction is between evidence about a scene and experience about how to reason with that evidence. 3DFusionMemory fuses current-scene observations into queryable spatial relations. A Spatial Skill Library provides reusable tool procedures, and Spatial Cognition associates task conditions with experience about when and how to use memory and skills. Completed trajectories are abstracted into process records and consolidated between task blocks, allowing later decisions to draw on earlier execution without transferring scene coordinates or reference answers. Across five spatial-reasoning benchmarks, SpatialBrain improves on direct answers from the same backbone on four and ties on the fifth. Component comparisons, experience-coverage curves, and traced resource decisions characterize how the framework accumulates and uses these resources.

AI.title_zh: SpatialBrain：从经验中生长的空间智能
AI.abstract_zh: 空间推理需要的不仅仅是能够使用几何工具：推理者必须判断何时直接观察已足够，以及何时需要重建、测量或改变参考系。我们提出 SpatialBrain，一个在保持其视觉-语言主干固定的同时，保留关于这些决策的经验的框架。其关键区分在于关于场景的证据与关于如何利用该证据进行推理的经验之间的区别。3DFusionMemory 将当前场景的观测融合为可查询的空间关系。Spatial Skill Library 提供可复用的工具过程，Spatial Cognition 则将任务条件与关于何时以及如何使用记忆和技能的经验相关联。已完成的轨迹被抽象为过程记录，并在任务块之间进行整合，使后续决策能够借鉴先前的执行过程，而不传递场景坐标或参考答案。在五个空间推理基准上，SpatialBrain 在四个基准上优于同一主干的直接回答，并在第五个基准上与之一致。组件比较、经验覆盖曲线以及可追踪的资源决策刻画了该框架如何积累和使用这些资源。

title: LLM-Based Exogenous World Modeling for Dynamic Scheduling
summary: Dynamic scheduling requires dispatching online arrivals while anticipating future jobs, as poor decisions can compound downstream costs under nonlinear tardiness objectives. We show that a pretrained large language model (LLM) can serve as the exogenous component of a structured world model, forecasting uncertain future job arrivals. Specifically, we exploit an afterstate decomposition, which separates known deterministic shop transitions from uncertain exogenous job arrivals, enabling the LLM to forecast only the latter through a compact belief representation. Building on this, we develop Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP), which combines an evolved, belief-conditioned dispatching strategy with short scenario-based rollouts. A surprise-triggered refresh mechanism queries the LLM only when newly observed arrivals deviate sufficiently from previous forecast, and online residual self-calibration further conditions the LLM on its recent forecast errors to handle nonstationary arrivals. Across diverse arrival distributions, AWMP reduces weighted tardiness by 6-21% on dynamic job-shop and 22-46% on flexible job-shop benchmarks, relative to the best of eight classical priority-dispatching rules.

AI.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的外生世界建模用于动态调度
AI.abstract_zh: 动态调度需要在派发在线到达作业的同时预判未来作业，因为在非线性延误目标下，糟糕的决策会累积下游成本。我们表明，预训练大语言模型（LLM）可以作为结构化世界模型的外生组件，用于预测不确定的未来作业到达。具体而言，我们利用事后状态分解（afterstate decomposition），将已知的确定性车间状态转移与不确定的外生作业到达分离，使得 LLM 仅通过紧凑的信念表示（belief representation）来预测后者。在此基础上，我们提出事后状态世界模型规划（Afterstate World-Model Planning，AWMP），该方法将演化得到的、以信念为条件的派发策略与基于情景的短程推演（short scenario-based rollouts）相结合。一种由惊奇触发的刷新机制（surprise-triggered refresh mechanism）仅在新观测到的到达与先前预测偏离足够大时才查询 LLM，而在线残差自校准进一步以 LLM 近期的预测误差为条件，以处理非平稳到达。在多种到达分布下，相对于八种经典优先级派发规则中的最佳者，AWMP 在动态作业车间（job-shop）基准上将加权延误降低 6-21%，在柔性作业车间（flexible job-shop）基准上降低 22-46%。

title: Failure Modes of Vision-Language Models for Human Activity Understanding in Thermal HRI
summary: Thermal cameras enable robots to perceive human activities in darkness while revealing less personally identifiable appearance information and fewer details of the surrounding environment than RGB cameras. As vision-language models (VLMs), originally developed for RGB imagery, are increasingly integrated into embodied systems for scene understanding and high-level planning, thermal sensing offers a promising way to extend activity perception to low-light and privacy-sensitive settings. However, the failure modes of VLMs in thermal human activity understanding for human-robot interaction (HRI) remain underexplored. We fill this gap by evaluating seven locally deployable VLMs, including models developed for physical AI and robotics, on two person-centric thermal datasets. Our diagnostic tasks examine fine-grained action recognition, activity timeline reconstruction, and the ability to withhold unsupported answers. Paired RGB recordings serve as a performance reference, while controlled variations in frame sampling, thermal input presentation, and reasoning are used to assess whether the observed errors can be mitigated. Our results show that models can recognize broad activity categories but struggle with fine-grained actions such as coughing, sneezing, and yawning. They also produce inaccurate event timelines and hallucinate actions involving objects. Simple thermal input preprocessing and additional reasoning offer only limited, model-dependent gains. Abstention behavior also varies across models even under explicit instructions, limiting their reliability for practical robotic use.

AI.title_zh: 热成像人机交互中用于人类活动理解的视觉语言模型失效模式
AI.abstract_zh: 热成像相机使机器人能够在黑暗中感知人类活动，同时相比RGB相机泄露的可识别个人身份的外观信息更少，对周围环境的细节揭示也更少。随着最初为RGB图像开发的视觉语言模型（VLM）日益被集成到具身系统中用于场景理解与高层规划，热成像感知为将活动感知扩展到低光照和隐私敏感场景提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，VLM在面向人机交互（HRI）的热成像人类活动理解中的失效模式仍缺乏充分探索。我们通过在两个以人为中心的热成像数据集上评估七个可本地部署的VLM（包括为物理AI和机器人学开发的模型）来填补这一空白。我们的诊断任务考察细粒度动作识别、活动时间线重建以及拒绝给出无依据答案的能力。配对的RGB记录作为性能参照，同时对帧采样、热成像输入呈现方式和推理进行受控变化，以评估所观察到的错误能否被缓解。结果表明，模型能够识别宽泛的活动类别，但在咳嗽、打喷嚏和打哈欠等细粒度动作上表现不佳。它们还会产生不准确的事件时间线，并幻觉出涉及物体的动作。简单的热成像输入预处理和额外的推理仅带来有限且依赖模型的增益。即使有明确指令，弃答行为在不同模型之间也存在差异，这限制了它们在实际机器人使用中的可靠性。

title: Think-Capture: Active 3D Geometry Acquisition for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

AI.title_zh: Think-Capture：面向视觉-语言模型空间推理的主动三维几何获取
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在二维识别方面表现出色，但往往无法在稀疏视角之间保持一致的3D关系，从而在遮挡和视角变化下产生空间幻觉。现有方法通常以稠密几何的方式融合所有帧，带来大量计算与上下文开销，同时促使其盲目依赖并不完美的估计器。我们提出 Think-Capture，这是一个以查询为条件的框架，它首先识别任务关键对象，然后按需获取其几何信息。一个3D工具包将零样本掩码提升到统一的坐标系中，而符号化3D状态抽象（Symbolic 3D State Abstraction）则将对象与相机状态压缩为结构化文本。分层组相对策略优化（GRPO）在几何信息或有益或具误导性的案例上训练VLM，教会它何时使用工具证据、何时退回到视觉线索。Think-Capture-4B 在 MindCube-Tiny 上达到 54.4%（较其骨干模型提升 21.5 点），在 MMSI-Bench 位置子集上达到 39.1%（+7.9），在 ViewSpatial 上达到 42.8%（+5.2）。它在坐标和掩码扰动下也保持稳健。完整技术栈可容纳于一块 24 GB GPU，并作为 Agibot G1 上的异步高层推理器运行。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture 获取。

title: NeuralSRender: G-Buffer Guided Video Diffusion for Sim-to-Real Rendering
summary: The scarcity of high-quality annotated visual data remains a critical bottleneck for autonomous-driving perception. Simulators provide training data at scale, but the limited realism of synthetic videos compromises perception performance in real-world applications. To address this limitation, we propose NeuralSRender, a sim-to-real video translation framework that enhances the photorealism of synthetic videos while maintaining geometric consistency with the source scenes. Built on a pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT), NeuralSRender uses a lightweight projector to inject geometric and material priors from G-buffers, and LoRA enables parameter-efficient adaptation. The model is trained in two stages: it first learns G-buffer conditioning from synthetic videos with accurate G-buffers, then adapts to real-world appearance using real videos with estimated G-buffers. During the second stage, an additional LoRA module is trained while the projector and first-stage LoRA remain frozen to reduce interference from estimation noise. NeuralSRender introduces only 1.45\% parameter overhead and can be trained on consumer-grade GPUs with 24 GB of memory. To support training and evaluation, we introduce GenReal, a large-scale driving video dataset comprising synthetic and real-world videos with corresponding G-buffers. Experiments demonstrate improved photorealism with competitive geometric consistency. Training perception models on our translated videos instead of raw simulator renders improves detection $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ on nuImages from 35.1 to 40.6 and segmentation mIoU on Cityscapes from 32.4 to 40.8. Our code, data, and model weights are available at: https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender.

AI.title_zh: NeuralSRender：面向仿真到真实渲染的 G-Buffer 引导视频扩散
AI.abstract_zh: 高质量标注视觉数据的稀缺，仍是自动驾驶感知的一个关键瓶颈。仿真器能够大规模提供训练数据，但合成视频有限度的真实感会损害其在真实世界应用中的感知性能。为解决这一局限，我们提出 NeuralSRender，一种仿真到真实的视频翻译框架，它在保持与源场景几何一致性的同时，提升合成视频的照片级真实感。NeuralSRender 构建于预训练视频扩散 Transformer（DiT）之上，使用轻量级投影器注入来自 G-buffer 的几何与材质先验，并通过 LoRA 实现参数高效的适配。模型分两个阶段训练：首先从具有准确 G-buffer 的合成视频中学习 G-buffer 条件控制，随后利用带有估计 G-buffer 的真实视频适配真实世界外观。在第二阶段中，额外训练一个 LoRA 模块，同时保持投影器和第一阶段的 LoRA 冻结，以减少估计噪声带来的干扰。NeuralSRender 仅引入 1.45\% 的参数开销，并可在显存为 24 GB 的消费级 GPU 上训练。为支持训练与评估，我们提出 GenReal，一个大规模驾驶视频数据集，包含合成视频与真实世界视频及相应的 G-buffer。实验表明，其照片级真实感得到提升，同时具有有竞争力的几何一致性。与使用原始仿真器渲染结果相比，在我们的翻译视频上训练感知模型，可将 nuImages 上的检测 $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ 从 35.1 提升至 40.6，并将 Cityscapes 上的分割 mIoU 从 32.4 提升至 40.8。我们的代码、数据和模型权重可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender。

title: A Unified Evaluation Framework of Physical Adversarial Robustness in the Edge VLM Era
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD). 16 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable end-to-end visual grounding via language prompts and generative decoding, demonstrating largely improved zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection capabilities. As a result, VLMs are rapidly being deployed at the edge in safety-critical real-world systems. However, the physical adversarial robustness of edge VLMs has not been systematically studied, and the fundamental differences in output with modern object detectors create methodological challenges for fair evaluation. To compare the two families directly, we evaluate every selected representative model on one outcome: whether an adversarial patch worn on a person evades detection of the model. We report this by introducing a unified metric, conditional attack success rate (cASR), counted only on images the model still localizes under a matched gray occluder, and partition every failure into omission (no box), substitution (a box on the patch), and displacement (a box on neither). We benchmark the physical adversarial vulnerability of compact grounding VLMs against a range of object detectors, and find that the VLMs can be as vulnerable as the detectors. We disclose that failure mode is largely associated with the output format of a model rather than its architecture family. Of the three, only omission is visible to a downstream system; displacement and substitution return confident, well-formed boxes, making them potentially more dangerous failures. Further, we find that, under distribution shift, VLMs that primarily failed by omission instead shift to failing more by displacement/substitution. Thus, a grounding VLM can inherit the detector's vulnerability while showing the possibility to adopt more dangerous failure modes. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness.

AI.title_zh: 边缘 VLM 时代物理对抗鲁棒性的统一评估框架
AI.abstract_zh: 近期视觉-语言模型（VLM）的进展使得通过语言提示与生成式解码实现端到端的视觉定位成为可能，展现出大幅提升的零样本与开放词汇检测能力。因此，VLM 正迅速被部署于安全攸关的现实系统的边缘端。然而，边缘 VLM 的物理对抗鲁棒性尚未得到系统研究，且其输出与现代目标检测器之间的根本差异给公平评估带来了方法论上的挑战。为直接比较这两类模型，我们在单一结果上评估每一个选定的代表性模型：佩戴在人身上的对抗补丁是否能够规避该模型的检测。我们通过引入一个统一指标——条件攻击成功率（conditional attack success rate, cASR）来报告这一结果，该指标仅在模型于匹配的灰色遮挡物下仍能定位的图像上计数；并将每一次失败划分为漏检（omission，无框）、替换（substitution，框落在补丁上）和位移（displacement，框既不落在目标上也不落在补丁上）。我们对紧凑型定位 VLM 相对于一系列目标检测器的物理对抗脆弱性进行了基准评测，发现 VLM 可能与检测器一样脆弱。我们揭示，失败模式在很大程度上与模型的输出格式相关，而非与其架构族系相关。在这三类失败中，只有漏检对下游系统是可见的；位移与替换会返回置信度高、格式良好的框，使其成为潜在更危险的失败。进一步地，我们发现，在分布偏移下，主要因漏检而失败的 VLM 会转向更多地因位移/替换而失败。因此，一个定位 VLM 可以继承检测器的脆弱性，同时表现出采用更危险失败模式的可能性。我们的代码与数据见 https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness 。

title: How Representational Priors Shape Generalization in World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) are shown to substantially diverge under generalization performance based on their generative backbones. We investigate this gap through the representational geometry that WAMs inherit from their backbones and how policy training reorganizes it. Our central hypothesis is that a useful representational prior would structure geometry that separates nuisance information from the in-distribution manifold in advance of training as a policy. We quantify this with nuisance orthogonality; orthogonality of the feature under visual variation outside the empirical in-distribution manifold. Across various image and video backbones, we show that a higher orthogonality from the representational prior is associated with stronger robustness to visual variations after WAM training, enabling policy generalization measurable prospectively for world models. In addition, analyzing the resulting robust WAMs reveals nuisance suppression; relative suppression of feature displacement caused by such variations and robust action generation of the policy. Together, these findings provide a geometric perspective on how the representational prior of the world model shapes the generalization performance of WAMs.

AI.title_zh: 表征先验如何塑造世界动作模型中的泛化
AI.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）被表明会依据其生成式骨干网络在泛化性能上出现显著分化。我们通过 WAMs 从其骨干网络继承的表征几何结构以及策略训练如何重构该几何结构来研究这一差距。我们的核心假设是：有用的表征先验会在作为策略进行训练之前，就预先构造出将冗余（nuisance）信息与分布内流形相分离的几何结构。我们用冗余正交性（nuisance orthogonality）来量化这一点；冗余正交性指在经验分布内流形之外的视觉变化下特征的正交性。在各种图像和视频骨干网络上，我们表明，来自表征先验的更高正交性与 WAM 训练后对视觉变化更强的鲁棒性相关联，从而使世界模型的策略泛化能够被前瞻性地度量。此外，对所得鲁棒 WAMs 的分析揭示了冗余抑制；即对此类变化引起的特征位移的相对抑制，以及策略的鲁棒动作生成。总之，这些发现为世界模型的表征先验如何塑造 WAMs 的泛化性能提供了一个几何视角。

title: Steering Black-Box Large Language Model Agents with Pitfall Anticipation World Model
summary: Frontier black-box Large Language Model (LLM) agents are proficient at long-horizon reasoning and precise action generation. However, when it comes to a specific agentic task, they have no internalized knowledge of how that particular environment unfolds. A world model offers a natural remedy, providing the agent with environment specific knowledge by foreseeing how the environment will respond to the action it is about to take. Prior world models for LLM agents mainly predict next observations at each step, which is costly and often uninformative because individual observations provide limited task-relevant guidance and not every step requires call for foresight. This raises a key question: what a world model should predict and when should it be invoked for agentic tasks? Our pilot study suggests that world model guidance is most useful when it anticipates pitfalls within a bounded multi-step future. Motivated by this, we introduce Pitfall Anticipation World Model (PAWM), which selectively intervenes when a potential pitfall arises and predicts the impending failure to steer the agent away from it. PAWM is trained in two stages: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on synthetic data labeled with agent pitfalls, followed by GRPO co-training with a black-box LLM to further optimize it in the target environment. PAWM improves Claude Sonnet 4.5 performance by 24.3% on ScienceWorld and 7.7% on WebArena-Lite, outperforming a range of baselines. These results demonstrate that PAWM provides an effective form of world model guidance for black-box LLM agents.

AI.title_zh: 以陷阱预判世界模型引导黑盒大语言模型智能体
AI.abstract_zh: 前沿的黑盒大语言模型（LLM）智能体擅长长程推理与精确的动作生成。然而，面对某一具体的智能体任务时，它们并不具备关于该特定环境如何演化的内化知识。世界模型提供了一种自然的补救方式，它通过预见环境将如何回应智能体即将采取的动作，为智能体提供环境特定的知识。以往用于 LLM 智能体的世界模型主要在每个步骤预测下一观测，这种做法代价高昂且往往信息量有限，因为单个观测所提供的与任务相关的指导有限，而且并非每一步都需要诉诸前瞻。这引出了一个关键问题：对于智能体任务，世界模型应当预测什么，又应当在何时被调用？我们的初步研究表明，当世界模型在有界的多步未来内预判陷阱时，其指导最为有用。受此启发，我们提出了陷阱预判世界模型（Pitfall Anticipation World Model，PAWM），它在潜在陷阱出现时进行选择性干预，并预测即将发生的失败以引导智能体避开该陷阱。PAWM 分两个阶段训练：首先在使用标注了智能体陷阱的合成数据进行监督微调（SFT），随后与一个黑盒 LLM 进行 GRPO 协同训练，以在目标环境中进一步优化它。PAWM 使 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的性能在 ScienceWorld 上提升 24.3%，在 WebArena-Lite 上提升 7.7%，优于一系列基线方法。这些结果表明，PAWM 为黑盒 LLM 智能体提供了一种有效的世界模型指导形式。

title: PhyMo: Learning Physical Dynamics with Accurate and Continuous Motion from Multi-View Videos
summary: Recovering dynamic 3D scene geometry, appearance, and the physical motion states that govern scene evolution from multi-view videos is important yet challenging. A key difficulty is that appearance can be deceptive. Under rendering supervision alone, a model may fit the observed images by changing color or opacity to compensate for inaccurate deformation, rather than recovering the true evolving geometry and motion. This issue is especially severe in scenes with fast or locally complex motion, where inaccurate trajectories can still produce plausible images over the observed frames, but lead to unreliable reconstruction and discontinuous future prediction. In this paper, we propose PhyMo, a framework for learning evolving dynamics from multi-view videos. We introduce a Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation that drives the model to recover accurate motion from deformation, rather than relying on appearance shortcuts to explain observed motion. On top of this, we propose a Continuous Motion Evolution module with bidirectional kinematic continuity constraint to promote temporally consistent evolution of displacement, velocity, and acceleration. Together, these designs yield geometrically faithful interpolation and continuous motion extrapolation. Experiments on four dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.

AI.title_zh: PhyMo：从多视角视频中学习具有准确且连续运动的物理动力学
AI.abstract_zh: 从多视角视频中恢复动态三维场景的几何、外观以及支配场景演化的物理运动状态是一项重要但又具有挑战性的任务。一个关键难点在于外观可能具有欺骗性。仅依靠渲染监督，模型可能通过改变颜色或不透明度来补偿不准确的形变，从而拟合观测到的图像，而不是恢复真实的演化几何与运动。该问题在具有快速或局部复杂运动的场景中尤为严重：不准确的轨迹仍可能在观测帧上产生看似合理的图像，但会导致不可靠的重建以及不连续的未来预测。在本文中，我们提出 PhyMo，一个从多视角视频中学习演化动力学的框架。我们引入了一种运动感知轨迹表示（Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation），促使模型从形变中恢复准确的运动，而不是依赖外观捷径来解释观测到的运动。在此基础上，我们提出了一个带有双向运动学连续性约束的连续运动演化模块（Continuous Motion Evolution module），以促进位移、速度和加速度在时间上一致的演化。这些设计共同实现了几何上忠实的插值与连续的运动外推。在四个动态场景基准上的实验证明了最先进的性能。

title: Causal world models under physical parameter shifts
summary: World models predict how embodied systems evolve under actions, but their accuracy can degrade when physical conditions move outside the training distribution. We study two components of causal modeling: which inputs a predictor may use, and how its mechanism computes their effects. In a synthetic benchmark with shortcut features, a frozen dependency mask derived from paired interventions reduces mean out-of-distribution (OOD) RMSE from 1.769 for a fully connected predictor to 0.697, close to the generator-oracle mask (0.694). For robot link-mass extrapolation in CausalWorld, with disjoint training and test mass ranges, we develop finger-local world models in which link masses enter inertia and dynamics-bias terms through explicit affine coefficients, actions act through either a learned torque network or the known PD controller, and learned residuals capture contact-related effects. Compared with a separately trained control whose mass inputs are fixed at training means, the known-PD model turns out-of-range masses into a consistent predictive gain: median time-averaged joint R2 over 150-step rollouts rises from 0.609 to 0.727, with improvement in all ten task-seed runs (exact two-sided sign test, p = 0.002). In a shared 100-step forecast, the learned-torque model is competitive with the strongest recurrent robotic world model (RWM) configuration (median joint R2 of 0.755 - 0.768 versus 0.752), whereas supplying out-of-range masses sharply degrades the MLP and recurrent predictors. These results indicate that how a physical parameter enters the dynamics mechanism determines whether its out-of-range value helps or harms prediction.

AI.title_zh: 物理参数偏移下的因果世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型预测具身系统在动作作用下如何演化，但当物理条件超出训练分布时，其准确性可能下降。我们研究因果建模的两个组成部分：预测器可以使用哪些输入，以及其机制如何计算这些输入的影响。在带有捷径特征（shortcut features）的合成基准上，由配对干预导出的冻结依赖掩码（frozen dependency mask）将平均分布外（OOD）RMSE 从全连接预测器的 1.769 降至 0.697，接近生成器神谕掩码（generator-oracle mask）的 0.694。针对 CausalWorld 中的机器人连杆质量外推，且训练与测试质量范围不相交，我们开发了指部局部世界模型（finger-local world models）：其中连杆质量通过显式仿射系数进入惯性项和动力学偏置项，动作通过学习得到的力矩网络或已知的 PD 控制器起作用，学习得到的残差捕捉与接触相关的影响。与单独训练的、其质量输入固定为训练均值的对照相比，已知 PD 模型将超出范围的质量转化为一致的预测增益：150 步推演上的中位时间平均关节 R2 从 0.609 升至 0.727，且在全部十次任务-种子运行中均有改善（精确双侧符号检验，p = 0.002）。在共享的 100 步预测中，学习力矩模型与最强的循环机器人世界模型（RWM）配置具有竞争力（中位关节 R2 为 0.755–0.768 对 0.752），而提供超出范围的质量则会使 MLP 和循环预测器显著退化。这些结果表明，物理参数如何进入动力学机制，决定了其超出范围的值是有助于还是有害于预测。

title: OccJEPA: Occlusion as Masking for Amodal Video Segmentation
comment: 20 pages (8-page main paper + supplementary material). Code: https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa
summary: Amodal video segmentation asks for the complete mask of an object in every frame, including the parts hidden behind other objects. The best current methods generate these masks with fine-tuned video diffusion models, which need many denoising steps and an extra depth network, and give a different answer for every sample. Self-supervised video world models of the JEPA family are trained on a closely related task: predicting the representation of masked space-time regions from the visible ones. We therefore treat occlusion as masking. The tokens that the object's visible mask does not cover are dropped, the pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor fills them in, and a light head decodes the observed and predicted features into amodal masks. The resulting model, OccJEPA (Occlusion-as-masking JEPA), is deterministic and 33.5x faster than the diffusion-based state of the art, and more accurate on SAIL-VOS, on TAO-Amodal, including a held-out test split (+4.00 AP50) and visible masks tracked by SAM2, and on Kubric. Controlled experiments trace the gain to the predictor's pre-trained weights rather than to its capacity, for world models from 87M to 1.85B parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa.

AI.title_zh: OccJEPA：将遮挡视为掩码用于非模态视频分割
AI.abstract_zh: 非模态视频分割要求给出每一帧中目标的完整掩码，包括被其他物体遮挡的部分。目前最好的方法使用微调后的视频扩散模型生成这些掩码，这需要许多去噪步骤和一个额外的深度网络，并且对每次采样都会给出不同的答案。JEPA 系列的自监督视频世界模型是在一项密切相关的任务上训练的：从可见的时空区域预测被掩码的时空区域的表示。因此，我们将遮挡视为掩码。目标可见掩码未覆盖的 token 被丢弃，由预训练的 V-JEPA 2.1 预测器将其填补，再由一个轻量头部将观测到的特征和预测的特征解码为非模态掩码。由此得到的模型 OccJEPA（Occlusion-as-masking JEPA）是确定性的，比基于扩散的当前最优方法快 33.5 倍，并且在 SAIL-VOS、TAO-Amodal（包括一个留出的测试划分，+4.00 AP50，以及由 SAM2 跟踪的可见掩码）和 Kubric 上更为准确。受控实验表明，这一增益源自预测器的预训练权重，而非其容量，涵盖从 87M 到 1.85B 参数的世界模型。代码见 https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa。

title: Can Quantum Layers offer Performance and Security Advantages in Vision-Language Models?
summary: As quantum computing moves from the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era toward early fault-tolerant quantum computing (EFTQC), quantum-enhanced AI is shifting from a conceptual idea to experimental research. Quantum components are expected to extend the capabilities of existing AI systems, yet it remains unclear how such components will help within large multimodal models. In this study, we try to answer that question for vision-language models (VLMs) using classically simulated quantum layers. With LLaVA-OneVision as the backbone, we evaluate 4- and 8-qubit basic-ring and strongly entangling circuits at four insertion and four replacement locations. Insertion adds quantum layers to the classical model, while replacement substitutes them for classical components. Using the same setup, we compare performance and computational cost between classical and quantum-classical hybrid models. On the Visual Spatial Reasoning dataset, inserting a quantum layer after the visual projector reaches 80.7% development accuracy, 2.28 percentage-points above classical full fine-tuning. Replacing the final decoder feed-forward sublayer retains 79.22% accuracy with 13.07 million fewer trainable parameters. Quantum insertion can thus improve accuracy, and selective replacement can reduce parameters. These benefits depend strongly on where the quantum layer is inserted or which classical component it replaces: earlier replacements lower accuracy, and fewer parameters do not reliably shorten training or reduce computation. To assess potential security benefits, we evaluated the robustness of quantum-classical hybrid models under six attack settings. Overall, our study maps where quantum layers help and hurt within VLMs, offering a starting point for hybrid VLM design; whether these gains generalize remains open. The code is available at https://github.com/TITANS-Lab-Artifacts/QuantumVLM.

AI.title_zh: 量子层能否为视觉-语言模型带来性能与安全优势？
AI.abstract_zh: 随着量子计算从含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）时代迈向早期容错量子计算（EFTQC）阶段，量子增强人工智能正从概念构想转变为实验研究。量子组件有望扩展现有AI系统的能力，然而这类组件将如何在大规模多模态模型中发挥作用仍不明确。在本研究中，我们使用经典模拟的量子层，尝试针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）回答这一问题。我们以LLaVA-OneVision作为骨干模型，在四个插入位置和四个替换位置上评估了4量子比特和8量子比特的基本环形电路与强纠缠电路。插入是指向经典模型中加入量子层，而替换则是指用量子层替代经典组件。采用相同的设置，我们比较了经典模型与量子-经典混合模型的性能和计算成本。在Visual Spatial Reasoning数据集上，在视觉投影器之后插入量子层达到了80.7%的开发集准确率，比经典全量微调高出2.28个百分点。替换最后一个解码器前馈子层则保留了79.22%的准确率，同时可训练参数减少了1307万个。因此，量子插入能够提升准确率，而选择性替换能够减少参数。这些收益在很大程度上取决于量子层插入的位置或其所替换的经典组件：较早位置的替换会降低准确率，而参数更少并不能可靠地缩短训练时间或减少计算量。为评估潜在的安全收益，我们在六种攻击设置下评估了量子-经典混合模型的鲁棒性。总体而言，本研究刻画了量子层在VLM中何处有益、何处有害，为混合VLM设计提供了一个起点；这些收益能否泛化仍有待研究。代码可在 https://github.com/TITANS-Lab-Artifacts/QuantumVLM 获取。

title: Pair-Free Coarse-to-Real Video Generation via Real-to-Coarse Image Supervision
summary: Coarse-to-real (C2R) video generation converts coarse animation, simulation, or game-rendered videos into photorealistic videos while preserving scene layout, camera motion, and dynamics. Training such models requires aligned (coarse, realistic) video pairs, which are expensive to create and confine prior systems to narrow synthetic domains. We exploit a simple asymmetry: paired videos are hard to obtain, but paired real-to-coarse images are easy to construct with existing editing and 3D reconstruction tools. Using these image pairs, we train the DINO-R2C model to transfer realistic images to coarse images in DINO feature space, and apply it frame-wise to ordinary real videos to synthesize pseudo-coarse videos. The C2R# model then learns to generate each real video from its pseudo-coarse counterpart, free from needing (coarse, realistic) video pairs. At inference, the DINO-R2C model is discarded and actual coarse videos drive the C2R# model directly. Thus, our pair-free training scales with any real-video corpora rather than with paired synthetic videos. We will release the model and project webpage at https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real-sharp/.

AI.title_zh: 基于真实到粗略图像监督的无配对由粗到真视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 由粗到真（coarse-to-real，C2R）视频生成将粗略的动画、仿真或游戏渲染视频转换为照片级真实感视频，同时保持场景布局、相机运动和动态变化。训练此类模型需要对齐的（粗略，真实）视频对，而这些视频对制作成本高昂，并将以往系统限制在狭窄的合成域内。我们利用一种简单的不对称性：成对视频难以获取，但成对的真实到粗略（real-to-coarse）图像却易于用现有的编辑和三维重建工具构建。利用这些图像对，我们训练 DINO-R2C 模型在 DINO 特征空间中将真实图像转换为粗略图像，并将其逐帧应用于普通真实视频以合成伪粗略视频。随后，C2R# 模型学习从其伪粗略对应视频生成每个真实视频，无需（粗略，真实）视频对。在推理时，DINO-R2C 模型被丢弃，实际的粗略视频直接驱动 C2R# 模型。因此，我们的无配对训练可随任意真实视频语料库扩展，而非随成对合成视频扩展。我们将在 https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real-sharp/ 发布模型和项目网页。

title: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
comment: Accepted at Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: We present HyperDrone, an extremely fast quadrotor simulator focused on high-performance batch rendering that is more than 20x faster than existing state-of-the-art batch quadrotor simulators. HyperDrone combines highly optimized multirotor dynamics with HyperLux, a new ray-tracing engine that supports Nvidia OptiX, Vulkan, Apple Metal and WebGPU backends that takes full advantage of modern ray-tracing hardware, capable of running both components entirely on the GPU. HyperLux renders RGB, depth, semantic/instance segmentation, surface normals and optical flow observations at configurable levels of fidelity, including reflections, realistic lighting, motion blur, anti-aliasing, and Physically Based Rendering (PBR). Even in the highest-fidelity settings, HyperLux achieves millions of Frames Per Second (FPS) on consumer-grade GPUs while rendering realistic 3D scenes. We demonstrate the merits of HyperDrone by training a vision-based yaw-control policy purely in simulation and transferring it to a real small-scale quadrotor (Crazyflie) with a camera, running completely onboard.

AI.title_zh: HyperDrone：每秒百万帧的仿真到现实迁移
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 HyperDrone，一个速度极快的四旋翼飞行器模拟器，专注于高性能批量渲染，其速度比现有最先进的批量四旋翼模拟器快 20 倍以上。HyperDrone 将高度优化的多旋翼动力学与 HyperLux 相结合——后者是一个新的光线追踪引擎，支持 Nvidia OptiX、Vulkan、Apple Metal 和 WebGPU 后端，充分利用现代光线追踪硬件，能够将两个组件完全在 GPU 上运行。HyperLux 以可配置的保真度级别渲染 RGB、深度、语义/实例分割、表面法线和光流观测，包括反射、真实感光照、运动模糊、抗锯齿以及基于物理的渲染（PBR）。即使在最高保真度设置下，HyperLux 也能在消费级 GPU 上渲染逼真的 3D 场景，同时达到数百万帧每秒（FPS）。我们通过纯粹在仿真中训练一个基于视觉的偏航控制策略、并将其迁移到一架搭载摄像头的真实小型四旋翼飞行器（Crazyflie）上完全机载运行，来展示 HyperDrone 的优势。

title: Self-Improving Agents with World Model Predictive Paths
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.title_zh: 具有世界模型预测路径的自我改进智能体
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益被期望与环境交互并在部署过程中改进其决策。然而，预测未来结果与利用积累的交互经验如何共同支持决策，仍鲜有探索。我们提出了一个受模型预测路径积分（Model Predictive Path Integral, MPPI）控制启发的测试时框架，将多分支预测分析与基于经验的自适应相结合。在每一步，智能体提出多个候选动作，并用世界模型想象其结果，从而能够在不于环境中执行的情况下比较各备选方案。由于语言环境既不提供显式的动力学也不提供代价，所预测的结果会针对任务进展和风险进行评估，而对所得代价施加的 MPPI 风格权重则引导最终决策。双分支经验记忆实现了自我改进：规划器分支改进候选生成与动作选择，而世界模型分支改进下一观测的预测。在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上跨三个骨干模型的实验表明，我们的方法整体性能强劲，且经验引导的预测控制是有效的。我们的代码将公开提供。

title: WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State
summary: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits. A hierarchical planner over a typed decision model emits structured decision state: Macro fixes settlement, ecology, transport, and hydrological structure across a group of tiles; Micro specializes that contract into tile semantics under measured terrain and accepted neighbor commitments. Deterministic local code compiles accepted plans into terrain, roads, settlements, vegetation, and entities. Streaming separates their reach: plans run ahead along the predicted corridor, compilation only where movement will soon need it, geometry behind the user released. One world record retains plans, seeds, object identities and mutable state, boundary commitments, and edits by attribute, revised as the user advances and edits; returning tiles recompile from it. The same record grounds interaction: the model acts on existing entities, including stateful NPCs that update as they act, edits the present region, or attaches intent to unplanned regions. Together they yield a world expanding under bounded budgets, connected across independently planned tiles, and interactive.

AI.title_zh: WorldStream：以分层规划与持久状态流式生成可交互三维世界
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 WorldStream，一个具备三项同时实现能力的开放式三维世界模型：它将可游玩地形扩展到任何预先指定的地图之外，在运行中的世界里响应开放式语言指令，并恢复访问过的地点及其编辑。一个基于类型化决策模型的分层规划器输出结构化决策状态：Macro 在一组瓦片（tile）范围内确定聚落、生态、交通与水文结构；Micro 在实测地形和已接受的邻接承诺（neighbor commitments）下，将该契约特化为瓦片语义。确定性的本地代码把已接受的规划编译为地形、道路、聚落、植被与实体。流式处理（Streaming）区分它们的作用范围：规划沿预测走廊提前运行，编译只在移动即将需要之处进行，用户身后的几何则被释放。一条世界记录（world record）保留规划、种子、对象标识与可变状态、边界承诺（boundary commitments）以及按属性记录的编辑，并随用户推进与编辑而更新；返回的瓦片由此重新编译。同一条记录也为交互提供依据：模型作用于已有实体（包括随其行为而更新的有状态 NPC），编辑当前区域，或将意图附加到未规划区域。这些能力共同产生一个在有界预算下持续扩展、在独立规划的瓦片之间保持连通、且可交互的世界。

title: Second Thoughts: Exploring and Planning through Comparative Imagination in World Models
summary: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.

AI.title_zh: 再度思考：在世界模型中通过比较性想象进行探索与规划
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型使智能体能够在行动之前比较想象出的结果，但智能体仍须决定要探索哪些备选方案，以及一个所提出的计划何时应当取代其已学习到的策略。我们提出 SDI（Sibling Disagreement in Imagination，想象中同源分歧），它通过一个共享的基于行动者（actor）的参照将上述决策联系起来。SDI 比较从同一模型状态出发所想象的动作序列，通过对行动者自身序列的重复推演（rollout）来度量固定行为下的变异。这一参照同时用于缩放候选回报之间的离散程度（其提供探索信号）以及所提出计划的预测优势（其支配动作接受）。当计划的优势以固定倍数超过参照变异性时，智能体执行该计划动作；否则，它遵循行动者。SDI 复用基础智能体的世界模型、行动者和评论者（critic），无需额外的分歧集成。探索与规划引导训练数据的收集，而评估仅使用已学习到的行动者。在 Meta-World、Adroit 和 DM-Control 上，SDI 在每个测试套件中都取得了比所有对比基线更高的观测任务平均得分，并在 18 个任务中的 15 个上达到或超过最强基线的性能。组件消融与鲁棒性分析进一步考察了探索、规划暴露和动作接受的作用。来自相同模拟器状态的配对评估表明，相对于无门控的规划，该门控既改善了从行动者失败中的恢复，也改善了对成功行为的保持，同时大幅降低了回报的退化。总体而言，这些结果支持将想象出的备选方案与共享的行动者参照进行比较，作为以世界模型进行探索与规划的统一方法。

title: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
comment: Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), November 14-17, 2026, Milan, Italy
summary: Autoregressive foundation models offer state-of-the-art capabilities to simulate the market by generating the message flow of limit order books (LOBs). Yet, without understanding their inner workings, research directions are hard to narrow and practical use in real-world trading environments remains uncertain. This study therefore asks what these models actually learn about market microstructure. We find that, similarly to games where sequence models build an internal representation of the board, an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trained autoregressively on the tokenized message stream of eight large-cap US equities learns an internal representation of the market and its dynamics. In particular, order-flow imbalance, a central driver of short-horizon price moves, is decodable at $R^2 \approx 0.59$, far above controls and baselines. This representation extends to unseen stocks, suggesting that these models learn general representations rather than ticker-specific patterns. The model also generalizes across metrics beyond order-flow imbalance: results hold across traded volume and volatility. Additionally, the representation is causally steerable: pushing the state along a feature's axis shifts the model's next-message beliefs as that feature implies, monotonically in dose, consistent with the emergence of a world model.

AI.title_zh: 理解用于限价订单簿的状态空间基础模型的内部工作机制
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归基础模型通过生成限价订单簿（LOB）的消息流，为模拟市场提供了最先进的能力。然而，若不理解其内部工作机制，研究方向的收窄将十分困难，而在真实交易环境中的实际应用仍不确定。因此，本研究追问：这些模型究竟学到了关于市场微观结构的什么内容。我们发现，与序列模型在棋类游戏中构建棋盘的内部表征相类似，一个拥有 8.2M 参数的 Mamba-3 状态空间模型在八只美国大盘股的分词化消息流上进行自回归训练后，学到了市场及其动态的内部表征。具体而言，订单流不平衡——短周期价格变动的核心驱动因素——可以以 $R^2 \approx 0.59$ 的可决系数被解码出来，远高于对照组和基线。这一表征可扩展至未见过的股票，表明这些模型学到的是通用表征，而非针对特定股票代码的模式。该模型在订单流不平衡之外的指标上也具有泛化性：结果在交易量和波动率上同样成立。此外，该表征在因果上是可操控的：沿某一特征的轴推动状态，会按照该特征所蕴含的方向改变模型对下一条消息的信念，且随剂量单调变化，这与世界模型的出现相一致。
